customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be a good value for money, with one mentioning it's suitable for a family of 4 to 5 people. The product receives positive feedback for its reliability, installation convenience, and appearance, particularly noting its sleek all-black design. They like the taste, with one customer mentioning the TDS level of 50 ppm gives the water a pleasant taste. However, several customers strongly advise against purchasing this product.

reviews.author: pavan
reviews.title: Good product value for money
reviews.body: I am very happy with my Aquaguard water purifier. The installation service was excellent and everything was done perfectly

reviews.author: K PRATAPAN
reviews.title: Service after sales
reviews.body: Writing this review after using six months. Product is very good and working without any problem. However I didn't get any support from the firm for fitment and I have contact a local firm for the same. Presently again Iam facing problem for guaranteed free servicing as customer service is pathetic and unable to provide support for servicing. I think people should be aware which company can provide service after sales.

reviews.author: Kusum Jasuja
reviews.title: Great product! Installation by company personnel very satisfactory
reviews.body: Great product! Installation by company personnel very satisfactory

reviews.author: ABHISHEK KUMAR
reviews.title: All accessories included in product
reviews.body: Product is good ..came with pre filter sediment and tds meter and other accessories required

reviews.author: Abhi
reviews.title: Good Product and Worth Buying
reviews.body: I’ve been using the Aquaguard water purifier and I’m quite happy with it. The water tastes clean and fresh, and the purifier works well. The design is also nice and fits perfectly in the kitchen. Overall, a good product and worth the money.
